entities.summary: Trofa, Segadães e Lamas do Vouga is a freguesia in Águeda Municipality, Aveiro District, Portugal. The population in 2011 was 4,630, in an area of 16.07 km2. The Ponte do Cabeço do Vouga and the Igreja de Trofa are located in this freguesia.
